description: This file defines the InterviewAttachmentAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing interview attachments in the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting interview attachments, along with associated validation rules and Swagger documentation annotations.

classes.name: InterviewAttachmentAPI
classes.description: API class for managing interview attachments associated with interviews in the recruitment module, supporting CRUD operations and validation.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all interview attachments for a specified interview, with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new attachment to a specified interview, including processing base64-encoded file data.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific interview attachment by attachment ID and interview ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update details of an existing interview attachment, with options to replace the file content.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove one or more interview attachments based on provided IDs.
